screens.notes: Own top-level custom element (app-training-catalog-settings-view), sibling to the other two settings screens. **Redesigned 2026-08-04**: owns a brand-new, independent pair of tables (catalog_cycles, catalog_modules) — not the training_cycles/modules pair Año académico used to use (those, plus academic_years/academic_year_modules, were dropped). No FK from any other table into this catalog, so deletion is never dependency-blocked: deleting a cycle cascades to its modules, no confirmation, no blocked-message element needed (unlike the old design's catalog-training-cycle-delete-blocked-message/catalog-module-delete-blocked-message/catalog-module-edit-confirm-modal, all removed — there's nothing left to reference this catalog and block against). Follows lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md: inline editing, master/detail cascade (catalog-training-cycle-table drives catalog-module-table). Seeded once from the BOC PDFs in documentation/ — a one-off data load outside this UI, not a button here.

screens.notes: REAL BACKEND — 2026-08-05 redesign. Año académico gets a persisted data layer again: academic_years (per-teacher rows, start_year integer displayed as e.g. "2026-2027", is_current flag) and academic_year_modules (join to catalog_modules — a row's cycle is derived via catalog_modules.catalog_training_cycle_id, not stored again). No more creating/editing catalog cycles/módulos from this screen (that's Ciclos/Módulos' job, un-scoped/global as of the 2026-08-05 catalog redesign) — training-cycle-table-add-button, training-cycle-delete-blocked-message, module-table-add-button, module-delete-blocked-message and module-edit-confirm-modal are REMOVED (previously stubbed only, never wired to a real backend). module-selection-add-button is also REMOVED — module-selection-table now lists catalog_modules' fixed rows to check, not user-created free rows. New: academic-year-toast, a reusable floating notification (see its own entry) replacing academic-year-delete-blocked-message's old inline-paragraph pattern for this screen's two error cases. Own top-level custom element (app-academic-year-settings-view), sibling to the other two.

interactions.response: GET the selected year's assigned módulos; reloads training-cycle-table (derived cycles) and module-table from the response

interactions.trigger: row Editar, then submit a new start year
interactions.response: PATCH the row's start_year. 200 updates the row. 409 (duplicate start year for this teacher) shows academic-year-toast with the conflict and keeps the row in edit mode
PATCH marks this row current and un-marks whichever was current before, both reflected from the response
DELETE the row. 204 removes it. 409 (HAS_DEPENDENTS — módulos still assigned) shows academic-year-toast explaining the block; row stays
Discards the draft and any in-progress cycle/módulo selection, returns to normal mode

states.name: normal-populated
states.description: Cycles derived from the selected academic year's assigned módulos (a cycle appears here only while it has ≥1 assigned módulo) — read-only, no create/rename/delete (that's Ciclos/Módulos' job)

states.name: adding-mode
states.description: Shows every cycle in the shared catalog_cycles catalog (not filtered to this teacher) with a checkbox column, so the teacher can check one or several to add to the in-progress selection — entered either via academic-year-table-add-button (brand-new year) or training-cycle-table-add-cycle-button (adding to the already-selected existing year)
states.condition: academic-year-table-add-button or training-cycle-table-add-cycle-button was just clicked

interactions.trigger: click a row in normal mode
interactions.response: Reloads module-table filtered to this cycle's módulos assigned to the selected academic year

interactions.trigger: check/uncheck a row in adding mode
interactions.response: Adds/removes this cycle from the in-progress selection; checking a cycle for the first time reloads module-selection-table with that cycle's catalog_modules, all unchecked (already-assigned módulos pre-checked and disabled when extending an existing year, so the teacher can't re-add what's already theirs)

components.note: Type 'table' with a props.is_read_only column set in normal mode and a checkbox (table-selectable-cell) column in adding mode — same elementId, mode-dependent rendering, matching the existing app's cascading master/detail pattern.

On success: creates academic_years + academic_year_modules rows, shows module-selection-save-message, returns to normal mode selecting the new year. POST every newly-checked módulo (already-assigned ones are pre-checked/disabled, not resent) for the already-selected academic year. On success: inserts the new academic_year_modules rows, shows module-selection-save-message, returns to normal mode with the same year still selected.

components.note: New, reusable component (not scoped to this view) — a floating, auto-dismissing notification, distinct from the existing inline '*-save-message' paragraph pattern used elsewhere in this app. This view is its first user: duplicate-start-year-on-edit and delete-blocked-by-dependents errors. Implemented as its own Web Component (e.g. app-toast) that any future view can reuse.
